# Security Policy

Oden is an experimental and independent fork of Deno. Security fixes and
compatibility updates may lag behind upstream. Do not assume that an upstream
Deno security advisory covers this fork or that Oden has an official audit.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not post exploit details, credentials, or sensitive reports in a public issue
or pull request.

Please use [Oden's private GitHub vulnerability reporting
page](https://github.com/taisan11/oden/security/advisories/new) if the
repository has private vulnerability reporting enabled. If that option is
unavailable, request a private contact method from the maintainer without
including vulnerability details in a public message.

Include the affected version or commit, platform, impact, and minimal
reproduction steps when submitting a private report.

For vulnerabilities in an unchanged upstream component, consider reporting
them privately to upstream Deno as well. Upstream reporting does not replace a
report to the Oden maintainer when this fork is affected.
